test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options to verify function signatures and custom docstrings are generated correctly
test_disable_function_signatures: test that disabling function signatures removes auto-generated signatures from pybind11 module docstrings
test_custom_docstrings: test that custom docstrings are applied to pybind11 bound functions as expected
test_overloaded_docstrings: test that docstrings are correctly combined for overloaded pybind11 function definitions
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that disabling user-defined docstrings suppresses custom docstrings on pybind11 bound objects
